title: Quantification of motor abnormalities with instrumental tasks among adolescents with first-episode schizophrenia and depressive disorders.
authors: Diao H, Wang H, Jia W, Han G, Liu Q, Li X, Wei K.
figures: The illustrations of the weight-holding task ( A ), the quiet standing task ( B ), and the straight walking task ( C ).
